patch_description: I redesigned the ansatz as a symmetric, low-parameter “shell + butterfly + phase-correction” block. The block uses mirrored RY and RX layers to keep the circuit expressive but regularized, a fixed CZ butterfly to spread correlations across the register, and two shared CRZ links to add trainable phase selectivity on the strongest entangling paths. This keeps the circuit efficient, reduces overfitting pressure, and makes the final block directly visible to the Z readout because it ends with RX instead of a trailing RZ layer.
